title: Integral scalar extension commutes with completed signed interchange
statement: Fix D,l,X, finite extensions E,L of Q_l and an algebra embedding i:E→L, coherent integral dualizing data wE,wL and arbitrary normalized rational Verdier data A,B [def-sf-rational-verdier-data], with their ambient signed symmetries natural in both variables. Let completedInterchange be the explicit completion conjugate of the supplied ordinary signed swap [lem-coef-rational-verdier-pairing-calculus], and T the integral scalar functor. For integral constructible K,M, T(completedInterchange_A(K,M));c_M,K = c_K,M;completedInterchange_B(TK,TM), where c is the normalized integralTensorScalarComparison [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Consequently localizing gives compatibility of the two calculi with the inverse normalized rational scalar tensorator. The integral core assertion contains no rationalization, evaluation, dual comparison or double-dual arrow.

theorem integral_scalar_interchange
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) L] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (i : E →ₐ[Padic l] L)
    (wE : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl E)
    (wL : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl L)
    (A : Datum D l hl X E wE) (B : Datum D l hl X L wL)
    (hA : ∀ (K M K' M' : IntegralHom.Derived.{u, u} X
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X))
      (f : K ⟶ K') (g : M ⟶ M'),
      A.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f g) ≫ (A.symmetry.swap K' M').hom =
        (A.symmetry.swap K M).hom ≫ A.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom g f))
    (hB : ∀ (K M K' M' : IntegralHom.Derived.{u, u} X
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L X))
      (f : K ⟶ K') (g : M ⟶ M'),
      B.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f g) ≫ (B.symmetry.swap K' M').hom =
        (B.symmetry.swap K M).hom ≫ B.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom g f))
    (K M : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) :
    (integralScalar l X E L i).map (completedInterchange D l hl X E wE A K M) ≫
        (@integralTensorScalarComparison l _ E _ _ _ L _ _ _ i X
          (units D l hl X) M K).hom =
      (@integralTensorScalarComparison l _ E _ _ _ L _ _ _ i X
          (units D l hl X) K M).hom ≫
        completedInterchange D l hl X L wL B
          ((integralScalar l X E L i).obj K) ((integralScalar l X E L i).obj M)
